name: IBY_DOCUMENT_LINES_H
description: IBY_DOCUMENT_LINES_H stores historical snapshots of document line items. This table contains denormalized versions of document lines from specific points in time, including when the payment for the associated document was submitted to a payment system. Different snapshots of the same document line can exist in this table. These snapshots are differentiated by the table's primary key and a snapshot date.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINE_HISTORY_ID
columns.description: System generated primary key

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINE_HISTORY_DATE
columns.description: Document line snapshot date

columns.name: DOCUMENT_PAYABLE_HISTORY_ID
columns.description: Document payable snapshot with which this line is associated

columns.name: DOCUMENT_PAYABLE_LINE_ID
columns.description: Oracle Payments' internal payment document line Identifier

columns.name: DOCUMENT_PAYABLE_ID
columns.description: Oracle Payments' internal payment document Identifier

columns.name: CALLING_APP_DOCUMENT_LINE_CODE
columns.description: Source product''s document line Identifier. Since document line Identifiers may be alphanumeric, even numeric document Identifiers are stored as VARCHAR2.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: PO_NUMBER
columns.description: Purchase order numbers to which this document line is matched. If multiple purchase orders, value is comma delimited.

columns.name: LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Line number

columns.name: LINE_TYPE
columns.description: Line type

columns.name: LINE_NAME
columns.description: Line name

columns.name: LINE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Line amount, in document currency

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Line description

columns.name: UNIT_PRICE
columns.description: Unit price

columns.name: QUANTITY
columns.description: Quantity

columns.name: UNIT_OF_MEASURE
columns.description: Unit of measure
